What We Design

Eight connected details shape the coffee service, guest comfort and street presence.

01

Counter & Bar Design

A welcoming service point planned around equipment, display and staff movement.

02

Seating Layout

Indoor, window and outdoor seats balanced with clear guest and service routes.

03

Lighting & Ambience

Warm layers of light for mornings, late evenings and flattering table settings.

04

Brand Styling & Décor

Colour, materials, furniture and details that make the brand feel at home.

05

Menu Board & Graphics

Clear menu presentation and graphic touchpoints placed where guests need them.

06

Kitchenette & Prep Area

A practical back counter for prep, storage, washing and daily service flow.

07

Facade & Signage

A recognisable shopfront that helps the café stand out from the street.

08

Acoustic Comfort

Materials and layout choices that soften noise without losing the café buzz.

Our Design Process

Five focused stages take the café from first conversation to an approved design package.

01

Consultation & Requirements

We discuss the coffee offer, guest profile, service style, budget and opening plan.

02

Site Measurement

We record the floor, frontage, services, equipment needs and existing conditions.

03

Concept & Layout Design

Counter, seating, prep and customer movement come together in one clear plan.

04

Material & Furniture Selection

Durable finishes, tables, seating, lighting and brand details are coordinated.

05

Final Design Package & 3D Visualization

Drawings and 3D views prepare the café for confident pricing and execution.

Pricing

The initial consultation and site survey are free. We confirm a fixed quote once the cover count, theme and 3D package are clear.

fields.heading: Café Design FAQs
fields.copy: Straight answers on customer appeal, capacity, workflow, timing, branding and 3D approval.

items.q: How can café design attract more customers?
items.a: A welcoming facade, memorable counter and comfortable atmosphere help people notice the café, step inside and return.

items.q: How many seats fit my café?
items.a: It depends on floor area, table mix, circulation and service flow. We test indoor, window and outdoor options before confirming the count.

items.q: Do you design the coffee counter and prep area?
items.a: Yes. We coordinate the customer-facing counter with equipment, storage, staff movement and the prep workflow behind it.

items.q: How long does café design take?
items.a: A compact café can take two to three weeks. Larger or themed spaces need more time for detailing and approvals.

items.q: Can you theme the café around my brand?
items.a: Yes. Colour, materials, graphics, furniture and lighting can express the brand in a warm, natural way.

items.q: Do I get 3D visuals before execution?
items.a: Yes. Key counter, seating and arrival views are shown in 3D before site work begins.
